Project.Brief history of your project and organi:
Shanghai Education Publishing Co., Ltd. Basic Education Second Branch (formerly "Shanghai Century Publishing Co., Ltd. Foreign Language Education Book Branch," hereinafter referred to as "Century Foreign Language Education") is a specialized publisher of foreign language textbooks for primary and secondary schools.

Century Foreign Language Education holds the legitimate publishing rights to the complete Shanghai Edition Oxford English series for primary, secondary, and preschool students (including audio-visual materials), originally introduced and published by Shanghai Education Publishing House in collaboration with Oxford University Press. The company focuses on foreign language textbooks for primary and secondary schools while also developing specialized and regionally tailored educational materials, as well as supplementary learning resources designed to complement these textbooks. Concurrently, Century Foreign Language Education actively collaborates with overseas publishing houses to introduce market-responsive foreign language educational products, including textbooks, reference books, teacher resources, and student reading materials.

Since its establishment, Century Foreign Language Education has actively participated in the editing and publishing of experimental textbooks for the national compulsory education English curriculum standards. The complete sets of primary and junior high school English textbooks (Shanghai Education Oxford Edition) have been approved by the National Textbook Review Committee for Primary and Secondary Schools. Consequently, Century Foreign Language Education holds two core textbook series: English (Shanghai Education Oxford Edition) and English (Oxford Shanghai Edition), establishing a significant presence in the field of foreign language textbook publishing for primary and secondary schools.
